_comment: RoadAware v2 model experiment config (notebook 11): three candidate families (Poisson, Random Forest, HGB) x five fixed feature variants, strong Train-only baselines, four expanding issue-time folds per unit (daily and 6 h separately), pooled-OOF selection, stability gate + exploratory paired calendar-block bootstrap, selection lock BEFORE 2024/2025 diagnostics. Configurations copy workflow/model-protocol-v2-draft.md unchanged; nothing here may be changed after observing V2 scores. Relative 'inputs' paths for protocol/lock resolve against the repository root, all others against the backend root. Env overrides (set by backend/scripts/run_v2_notebooks.py --stage model): ROADAWARE_BACKEND_ROOT, ROADAWARE_V2_OUTPUT_ROOT (root for reports/v2/models), ROADAWARE_V2_PREPARATION_DIR (read-only accepted notebook 10 report dir), ROADAWARE_V2_DATA_ROOT (read-only notebook 10 matrices), ROADAWARE_V2_MODEL_DATA_ROOT (row-level OOF/diagnostic predictions and fitted bundles, gitignored), ROADAWARE_V2_SOURCES_DIR (read-only 09 reports, only to cross-check source_run_id), ROADAWARE_V2_EXPERIMENT_LOCK. Research only: production_ready false, operational BLOCKED.

inputs.run_id_rule: preparation_run_id == preparation_manifest.json started_utc; source_run_id == 09 sources_manifest.json started_utc (cross-checked only while that file still has the sha256 recorded in the 10 manifest inputs)

time.fit_cell_rule: a cell may be fitted for a fold only when split == train AND training_eligible AND target_end_local <= issue time of the first evaluation date (previous day 18:00 Asia/Bangkok); identical boundary at every fold start and for the final fit

diagnostic_splits.name: development_2024
diagnostic_splits.label_th: 2024 development diagnostic (เคยเห็นแล้วตอนพัฒนา ไม่ใช่ test อิสระ)

diagnostic_splits.name: reused_seen_2025
diagnostic_splits.label_th: 2025 reused / previously-seen diagnostic (เคยใช้แล้ว ไม่ใช่ test อิสระ)

final_fit.note: No refit on 2024; no selection change from 2024/2025 scores; recent-history baselines stay frozen at the cutoff (no label updates during 2024/2025).

preprocessors.onehot_impute_scale: categoricals: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown=ignore) fitted on fold Train; numerics: SimpleImputer(median, add_indicator=False, keep_empty_features=True) + StandardScaler fitted on fold Train (all-missing Train columns kept as constant 0)
preprocessors.onehot_impute: categoricals: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown=ignore) fitted on fold Train; numerics: SimpleImputer(median, add_indicator=False, keep_empty_features=True) fitted on fold Train (no ordinal geography distance; all-missing Train columns kept as constant 0)
preprocessors.ordinal_native: categoricals: OrdinalEncoder(handle_unknown=use_encoded_value, unknown_value=NaN) fitted on fold Train and declared categorical to HGB; numerics passed through with NaN handled natively (all-missing columns kept)
preprocessors.missingness_note: No missingness-indicator predictors are added (weather/traffic missing or quality flags and source status are not approved inputs; API coverage is a retrospective sampling artifact, not proven historical availability). HGB native NaN handling can still split on missingness: source-coverage confounding is a documented limitation, diagnosed later via feature_missingness_by_split.csv / notebook 12.

daily.note: sparsity diagnostic; no finite Poisson deviance

6h.note: sparsity diagnostic; no finite Poisson deviance

baselines.definitions: All fitted on fold Train rows only. levels are applied coarse -> fine on top of the Train global mean (a finer level overrides only where its key was seen in Train; for 6 h the Train time-block mean is the explicit fallback parent of province-block). smooth: (sum_y_group + k * parent) / (n_group + k), parent = the levels prediction, unseen group -> parent. recent: mean of Train cells whose target_end_local > cutoff - days (90 calendar days of targets ending at the frozen fold-start issue time); a key with no recent cell falls back to the levels prediction (full Train, then block, then global). bl_weekday / bl_month derive from target_date only.

metrics.floor_rule: predictions must be finite and >= 0 (otherwise the fit is rejected, never clipped); the floor is applied ONLY inside Poisson deviance and its count reported; MAE/RMSE/WAPE/bias/totals use raw predictions; WAPE null when sum y == 0; zero baseline deviance is null

selection.rule: per unit independently: best configuration x variant per family by pooled row-weighted OOF mean Poisson deviance (exact ties -> method_id); best candidate across families by the same metric (exact ties -> family_order then method_id); strongest nonzero baseline by pooled OOF deviance (exact ties -> baseline id). Methods with any failed or rejected fold are excluded and reported.

bootstrap.statistic: row-weighted mean of (candidate - baseline) Poisson deviance over resampled 7-calendar-day blocks of the pooled OOF period (blocks anchored at the first OOF evaluation date; every province / time block of a day moves together)

gate.note: bootstrap is exploratory after model/variant selection, not adjusted for multiple comparisons; if the gate fails the strongest baseline is the recommended reference

compute.note: OMP/BLAS pools limited to 2 threads; RF n_jobs=2; preprocessors are fitted per fold/variant and shared only between configurations of the same preprocessor kind inside that fold
